name: Computer Engineering
blurb: The institute's largest department, running two B.Tech sections a year alongside M.Tech in Software Engineering and a doctoral programme.

name: Information Technology
blurb: Home of the Information Security specialisation and the department that sets the shared project documentation standards for computing students.

name: Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering
blurb: Communications, signal processing and IoT, with M.Tech streams in Digital Communication and IoT & Automation.

name: Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering
blurb: Measurement, control and digital instrumentation, offered at undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral level.

name: Mechanical Engineering
blurb: The only branch offered both full-time and part-time (BE PTDC), with M.Tech streams in Design & Thermal and Industrial Engineering & Management.

name: Civil Engineering
blurb: Structures, geotechnics and environmental engineering, admitting a single undergraduate section each year.

name: Computer Science and Business Systems
blurb: The institute's newest undergraduate branch, pairing computing fundamentals with business systems and its own CBCS syllabus track.

name: Applied Science
blurb: Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics — teaching the shared first year and running M.Sc Applied Mathematics plus three doctoral streams.
